description: This file defines a template class 'BaseRefCount' that implements reference counting for objects, inheriting from a generic CONTEXT class. It manages an internal reference count with thread-safe increment and decrement operations, and deletes itself when the count reaches zero.

classes.name: BaseRefCount
classes.description: A template class providing thread-safe reference counting, inheriting from a generic CONTEXT class.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count atomically and returns a status code.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count atomically, deletes the object if count reaches zero, and returns a status code.
